slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Gen 28:14: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth...All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
slides.body: “Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth...All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.”
slides.heading: Gen 28:14

slides.alt_text: Slide one introduces the claim that Jesus is Jacob's promised offspring.
slides.body: Genesis promises Jacob descendants like dust and worldwide blessing through his offspring. Luke later includes Jesus in the line Jacob, Isaac and Abraham.
slides.heading: Does Jacob's ‘offspring’ mean Jesus?

slides.alt_text: Slide two presents the Christian covenantal and genealogical case.
slides.body: The covenant passes through Jacob, and Luke deliberately places Jesus in that salvation-historical family. Read with the wider New Testament, Jesus becomes Israel's representative descendant bringing blessing to the nations.
slides.heading: The strongest Christian case

slides.alt_text: Slide three explains why descent from Jacob is too broad to predict Jesus uniquely.
slides.body: Genesis explicitly promises a multitude spreading across the land. Luke confirms Jesus's ancestry but does not interpret this verse. The basic criterion is shared across Israel; identifying Jesus as the representative blessing-bearer requires a later argument.
slides.heading: A family line isn't a unique prediction

title: Does being Jacob's descendant fulfil a prophecy?
